panels.description: Sum of grid-01 energy steps. Grid energy is the site total; submeters are not added on top of it, or energy would be double-counted.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(value) AS total_kwh FROM readings WHERE topic LIKE 'gridpulse/%/grid-01/energy_kwh' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Total energy — grid, selected period (kWh)

panels.description: Highest 15-minute grid power in the selected period. This peak, not average load, sets the demand charge.

targets.rawSql: SELECT MAX(value) AS peak_kw FROM readings WHERE topic LIKE 'gridpulse/%/grid-01/power_kw' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Peak load — grid (kW)

panels.description: Distinct sites present in readings in the selected period. If this drops below 2, one site's gateway or ingestion path is down.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT split_part(topic, '/', 2)) AS sites FROM readings WHERE $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Sites reporting

panels.description: Grid power per site. Mumbai Tower should show a daytime HVAC hump; Pune Plant should show shift plateaus with a midday furnace spike.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", value AS "mumbai-tower" FROM readings WHERE topic = 'gridpulse/mumbai-tower/grid-01/power_kw' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts
SELECT ts AS "time", value AS "pune-plant" FROM readings WHERE topic = 'gridpulse/pune-plant/grid-01/power_kw' AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY ts

panels.title: Site load (kW)

panels.description: Daily sum of grid energy steps, per site. Compare shape, not just totals: a high-rise and a plant should not have the same daily pattern.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('day', ts) AS "time", split_part(topic, '/', 2) AS "site", SUM(value) AS "kwh" FROM readings WHERE topic LIKE 'gridpulse/%/grid-01/energy_kwh' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Daily energy by site (kWh/day)

panels.description: Energy steps per asset, grid incomer excluded to avoid double-counting. Solar and BESS rows are absolute step values from the simulator, so read them as throughput, not net site energy.

targets.rawSql: SELECT split_part(topic, '/', 2) AS site, split_part(topic, '/', 3) AS asset, SUM(value) AS energy_kwh FROM readings WHERE unit = 'kWh' AND topic NOT LIKE 'gridpulse/%/grid-01/%' AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Top assets by energy (selected period)

panels.description: Grid energy x 0.71 kg/kWh (illustrative factor — replace with the issuing authority's current edition before any real ESG report).

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(value) * 0.71 / 1000.0 AS tco2e FROM readings WHERE topic LIKE 'gridpulse/%/grid-01/energy_kwh' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Carbon — location-based (tCO2e)

panels.description: Grid energy x 0.82 kg/kWh residual mix (illustrative, no RECs retired in the demo). Report location- and market-based side by side; never market-based alone.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(value) * 0.82 / 1000.0 AS tco2e FROM readings WHERE topic LIKE 'gridpulse/%/grid-01/energy_kwh' AND $__timeFilter(ts)

panels.title: Carbon — market-based (tCO2e)
